owner_and_capability: Identity & Access — operator identity and refresh sessions behind operator login, refresh, MFA lockout and session revocation; Audit — operator action ledger; owner account queries for People Directory, Care Plan parent and CLI reads
atomic_cutover: The retained operator and refresh-token repository contracts become adapters over the public Identity & Access capability and the platform audit repository over the Audit appender; the old platform repositories are deleted in the same change. Foreign auth.accounts and auth.tokens reads use owner queries bound at construction. The orphaned parent-account model, routes and client are removed. No dual provider or fallback read chain.
tests: Owner operator lifecycle, MFA lockout, rotation hand-off, revocation and expiry sweep; injected failure inside the administrative transaction with rollback and retry; observation row counts; adapter contract tests; audit ledger transaction join; fail-closed owner lookups; existing operator login/MFA/refresh/session-validation, parent dashboard and staff messaging suites; route goldens and architecture, composition and query-budget ratchets.

runtime_evidence.workload: 2026-09-10 local isolated PostgreSQL 17.11 clone, Go 1.27.0 darwin/arm64; five warmups plus 30 sequential login, refresh and revoke sequences over the public capability, refresh and revoke inside one administrative transaction each.
runtime_evidence.thresholds: No task-specific latency SLO or query budget is defined. Existing architecture, composition, query-budget and behavior gates apply; measured values are observations, not fitted thresholds or a production performance claim.
runtime_evidence.query_count: Login 3 statements and 2 DML rows; refresh 9 statements and 2 DML rows; revoke 4 statements and 2 DML rows, identical across all samples.
runtime_evidence.errors: 0/30 errors per operation; zero pool waits, 70 commits, zero rollbacks and zero database deadlocks including warmups.
runtime_evidence.failure: An injected failure after the session insert and login stamp rolls both back; the retry succeeds. A second rotation hand-off returns the stable ErrOperatorSessionRotated error; rotated predecessors are retained as replay evidence until expiry.
runtime_evidence.rollback: Session and login writes and the operator audit append roll back with the caller's administrative transaction in the integration tests; repeated grants and sweeps are idempotent.
runtime_evidence.smoke: Operator login, MFA, refresh replay and password-change revocation suites, four-portal session validation, parent dashboard listing, staff messaging reachability, cleanup CLI preview and the regenerated route goldens pass.

rollback_and_cleanup: Revert the composition and adapters against unchanged table shapes; no schema change and no irreversible cleanup. The parent-account routes had no caller and the table is empty in production.
exit_criterion: Every listed entry point reaches platform.operators, platform.operator_refresh_tokens, platform.operator_audit_log, auth.accounts and auth.tokens through one owner provider; scripts/backend-architecture.sh check removes the sixteen resolved keys, introduces none and leaves policy ownership unchanged.
